title: Pessimistic Offline Lock

validation.research: Six primary source notes. David Rice is credited for Pessimistic Offline Lock in Fowler’s catalog and Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture. PostgreSQL supports the distinction from transaction/session locks and the cost of long human-input transactions. SQLite supports targeted uniqueness handling and short write transactions; Python supports affected rows and random UUID acquisition identifiers. Logical ownership, ordinary read access, participation requirements, and abandoned-lock policy are explicit. The example and diagrams are original.
validation.python_examples: Actual checkout.py and demo.py fences execute with seven stated output lines exactly. Checks cover durable unique acquisition, competing refusal, fresh immutable acquisition handles, guarded save and release, stale cancel preserving a later token, revoked owners, release-failure rollback preserving title and reservation, title/ID limits, missing/corrupt-row acquisition rollback, missing protected data, connection-close abandonment and deliberate recovery, caller-owned transaction rejection, closed/default connections, and physical contention distinct from Busy. A direct SQL writer demonstrates the cooperative-protocol limit.

example_limits: Original note checkout uses a unique persistent lock row and a fresh UUID token per acquisition. Short acquire/save/cancel transactions are committed between editing requests. Acquisition atomically reserves and reads a title; competing acquisition raises Busy. Save checks the note/token predicate, writes, and removes ownership in one local transaction; cancellation removes only matching ownership. Stale handles cannot save through or release a later token. Read-only queries remain allowed. A reservation survives connection closing and requires explicit trusted recovery after abandonment. No lease/expiry/renewal, fairness queue, multi-resource protocol, authentication, external-resource fencing, or bypass-writer protection is implemented. Unknown-commit reconciliation is not implemented.
